cost_assumptions: Existing shared CPU; no new training, GPU work, downloads or paid services. Energy and monetary costs unmeasured.
limitations: One worker per reader/configuration, not repeated independent process trials.
CPU affinity is fixed but host CPUs, storage and page cache are shared.
Native mmap opens include metadata and file checksums; these are not bare C-open timings.
Full original-ID reconstruction warms OS page cache before query workers; no disk-cold claim.
Original trained checkpoints and queries reused; no new model quality, GPU or DATrie measurement.
